Let me analyze the examples more carefully to identify the correction rules.

Looking at Example 1 (2024-09-16):
- History: Prices declining from 72.14 to 64.99 over 18 days
- Model forecast: Starts at 63.69 and gradually increases
- True outcomes: Start at 63.21 and continue declining, but less than model forecasts

Looking at Example 2 (2024-05-02):
- History: Prices more volatile, starting around 63.39
- Model forecast: Starts at 72.92
- True outcomes: Start at 72.69

Example 3 (2024-05-03):
- History is similar to Example 2 but with 72.69 as the latest price
- Model forecast: Starts at 72.13
- True outcomes: Start at 71.84

Example 4 (2024-07-26):
- History: Prices around 70-67 range, some fluctuation
- Model forecast: Starts at 67.53
- True outcomes: Start at 67.71

Example 5 (2024-07-24):
- History is almost identical to Example 4 (last 18 prices are the same)
- Model forecast: Starts at 68.92
- True outcomes: Start at 68.90
